verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a cloud platform that ships a Python SDK and CLI, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The logs, metrics and OpenTelemetry export items cover observability of the user's own workloads, not opting out of Modal's tracking, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
